title: FLA import: Button symbol decoded as graphic — DefineButton2 lost on publish
description: FIXED (importer-side). Root cause: golden.fla stores PlayButton with Contents-stream symbol-type byte = 0 (graphic), not 1 (button) — verified against the raw bytes and both reference decoders (JPEXS flacomdoc FlaConverter.writeSymbols, fla-decoder extract_library). The on(release) handler lives on the instance (kind=button), which only button/movieclip instances can carry. Importer fix: flash8-import.ts now promotes any symbol placed as a button instance (buttonHandlers present) to symbolType:'button'. Compile reconciliation: generalized the graphicButtonSymbolIds pre-scan to 'symbols placed exclusively with instance-level handlers' (covers graphic/movieclip-used-as-button AND real button symbols), suppressing the redundant library-level definition so only the inline DefineButton2 (carrying handlers) is emitted — matching real Flash. Updated buttonactions/buttonkeypress unit tests (A/B/C/keyPress) which had codified the old 2-tag behavior to expect 1 tag per the golden oracle. Acceptance: node tools/golden-report.mjs => DefineButton2 1/1, DefineSprite 2/2, SELF-DETERMINISM PASS, 0 tag-count mismatches. Tests: core 5124 passed, swf 1285 passed (1 todo).
